history.summary: Tiny 42-unit freehold project on Lorong 24 Geylang. The asking $1,644 psf is roughly 20% ABOVE what the project actually transacts at — the algo's 'cheap' tag is a data quirk and is overridden by verified evidence.
history.rating_rationale: Web verification flatly contradicts the algo's age_adj_premium of -12.6%: actual recent Edenz Loft transactions cluster around ~$1,360 psf (the highest psf on record was ~$1,394 back in May 2019), so the $1,644 psf ask is ~20% above realistic value. The algo's OWN psf_premium_vs_cohort of +15.1% (its 'psf_overpriced' flag) is the accurate signal here, and appreciation_txns=7 (thin) makes the 2.73% CAGR unreliable. Independent reporting (EdgeProp/Yahoo 'Project Spotlight') singles out this cluster of Geylang freehold condos for having MORE loss-making than profitable resales — Edenz Loft itself showed 8 unprofitable vs 7 profitable exits. Add a 42-unit micro-project (poor liquidity), a Geylang address with resale/financing stigma, and no catalyst. Overpriced, illiquid, and with a documented loss history — a clear Avoid at high confidence.

appreciation_pct (2.73%) rests on only 7 txns — unreliable

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 2.73% CAGR over just 7 txns — statistically noisy and, per v3.4, no forward predictive value. History shows realized losses, not gains, for many sellers.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: ~4.2% quoted yield is mediocre for a freehold shoebox and does not compensate for the ~20% overpaying on entry; would-be yield is eroded by buying above market.
